channels.label: Position
channels.reason: Body position channel from a DC transducer.

channels.label: DX1
channels.reason: DX (Italian 'destra', right) EMG electrode 1 is right leg EMG, referenced to its pair DX2.

channels.label: DX2
channels.reason: Second electrode of the right leg EMG pair, used as the reference for DX1.

channels.label: MIC
channels.reason: Microphone with a sound transducer records snoring.

channels.label: C3
channels.reason: Unreferenced C3 electrode; the contralateral mastoid A2 (M2) is recorded separately.

channels.label: C4
channels.reason: Unreferenced C4 electrode; the contralateral mastoid A1 (M1) is recorded separately.

channels.label: ECG1
channels.reason: ECG electrode 1, referenced to its separately recorded pair ECG2.

channels.label: ECG2
channels.reason: Second ECG electrode, used as the reference for ECG1.

channels.label: A1
channels.reason: A1 is a mastoid reference electrode, not a target channel.

channels.reason: A2 is a mastoid reference electrode, not a target channel.

channels.reason: Right outer canthus EOG channel.
